Which statement about sodium oxide or nitrogen dioxide is correct?
A
Nitrogen dioxide is a solid at room temperature.
B
Nitrogen dioxide is acidic.
C
Sodium oxide has a lower melting point than nitrogen dioxide.
D
Sodium oxide is covalently bonded.

options.label: A
options.text: Nitrogen dioxide is a solid at room temperature.

options.label: C
options.text: Sodium oxide has a lower melting point than nitrogen dioxide.
